title: Past Continuous и Past Simple вместе

why: Past Continuous показывает процесс, который шёл в какой-то момент в прошлом (я работал, когда...), а Past Simple — короткое законченное событие. Вместе они дают картинку: на фоне длительного действия что-то произошло. По-русски эту разницу часто передают видом глагола (читал / прочитал), в английском — формой времени.
formation: • Past Continuous: was/were + V-ing (глагол с окончанием -ing). I was working. They were playing.
• Отрицание: wasn't / weren't + V-ing. She wasn't sleeping.
• Вопрос: Was/Were + подлежащее + V-ing? What were you doing?
• Past Simple для сравнения: V2 / did + V1. I saw, I didn't see, Did I see?
• Часто соединяют двумя словами: when (когда) + Past Simple, while (пока) + Past Continuous.
usage: 1. Процесс в конкретный момент прошлого. (At 8 p.m. I was cooking dinner. — В 8 вечера я готовил ужин.)
2. Длительное действие прервано коротким. Длинное — Past Continuous, короткое — Past Simple. (I was walking home when it started to rain. — Я шёл домой, когда начался дождь.)
3. Два процесса идут одновременно. (While she was reading, he was watching TV. — Пока она читала, он смотрел телевизор.)
4. Фон для рассказа. (The sun was shining and the birds were singing when we arrived. — Светило солнце и пели птицы, когда мы приехали.)
signalWords: while (пока), when (когда), as (в то время как), at that moment, at 5 o'clock yesterday, all evening, suddenly.
mistakes: • ✗ I was see him at the station. → ✓ I saw him at the station. Законченное короткое событие — Past Simple.
• ✗ While I walked home, it started to rain. → ✓ While I was walking home, it started to rain. После while обычно идёт процесс.
• ✗ I was working when he was coming. → ✓ I was working when he came. Короткое событие, которое прервало процесс, ставим в Past Simple.
• ✗ She were sleeping. → ✓ She was sleeping. С I/he/she/it — was, с you/we/they — were.
• ✗ I was knowing the answer. → ✓ I knew the answer. Глаголы состояния (know, want, like) обычно не используем с -ing.
remember: Past Continuous — фон и процесс (was doing), Past Simple — событие, которое на этом фоне случилось (did).

items.prompt: At nine o'clock last night I ___ (work) on my laptop.
They ___ (play) football at 5 p.m. yesterday.
She ___ (not / sleep) when I called.
What ___ you ___ (do) at midnight?
We ___ (have) lunch at one o'clock.
He ___ (listen) to music all evening.
It ___ (rain) when we left the office.
The children ___ (not / watch) TV at that moment.
I (a) was walking (b) walked in the park when I met my old friend.
While we (a) had (b) were having dinner, the phone rang.
She (a) was cutting (b) cut her finger while she was cooking.
He (a) was working (b) worked when the power went out.
When I (a) was arriving (b) arrived, the meeting was already going on.
What (a) were you doing (b) did you do at 7 p.m. yesterday?
They (a) were meeting (b) met at university in 2015.
The sun (a) was shining (b) shone, and people (a) were walking (b) walked along the beach.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глаголы в Past Continuous или Past Simple

items.prompt: I ___ (drive) to work when I ___ (see) an accident.
While she ___ (study), her brother ___ (play) video games.
He ___ (fall) asleep while he ___ (watch) a film.
We ___ (wait) for the bus when it ___ (start) to snow.
When the manager ___ (come) in, we ___ (discuss) the budget.
I ___ (not / hear) the alarm because I ___ (sleep).
She ___ (break) her phone while she ___ (run) for the train.
What ___ you ___ (do) when I ___ (call) you?
I was see a strange man near my house.
items.answer: I saw a strange man near my house.

items.prompt: While I walked to the station, I lost my wallet.
items.answer: While I was walking to the station, I lost my wallet.

items.prompt: She were cooking when the guests arrived.
items.answer: She was cooking when the guests arrived.

items.prompt: When we were arriving at the hotel, they gave us the keys.
items.answer: When we arrived at the hotel, they gave us the keys.

items.prompt: He didn't working when I came in.
items.answer: He wasn't working when I came in.

items.prompt: What you were doing at 10 p.m.?
items.answer: What were you doing at 10 p.m.?

items.prompt: I was wanting a coffee, so I went to the kitchen.
items.answer: I wanted a coffee, so I went to the kitchen.

items.prompt: They was talking when the teacher came in.
items.answer: They were talking when the teacher came in.

items.prompt: Когда ты позвонил, я принимал душ.
items.answer: I was taking a shower when you called. / When you called, I was taking a shower.

items.prompt: Пока я писал код, коллега готовил кофе.
items.answer: While I was writing code, my colleague was making coffee.

items.prompt: Что ты делал вчера в восемь вечера?
items.answer: What were you doing at eight o'clock yesterday evening?

items.prompt: Мы ждали самолёт, когда объявили задержку.
items.answer: We were waiting for the plane when they announced a delay.

items.prompt: Она упала, когда бежала по лестнице.
items.answer: She fell when she was running up the stairs. / She fell while she was running up the stairs.

items.prompt: Шёл дождь, и мы остались дома.
items.answer: It was raining, so we stayed at home. / It was raining and we stayed at home.

items.prompt: Я не слышал звонок, потому что слушал музыку.
items.answer: I didn't hear the bell because I was listening to music. / I didn't hear the phone because I was listening to music.

items.prompt: Сервер упал, пока мы проводили презентацию.
items.answer: The server crashed while we were giving a presentation. / The server went down while we were giving a presentation.
